messages:
Alice H.: Heads-up: strict output validator in repair-mode is routing ~3.6% of tool calls to fallback and we27re seeing duplicate token accounting.
Ben T.: Oof. Any minimal log sample?
Alice H.: Example: `tool_response: "{\"payload\": "[]"}"` expected object but got string -> validation_failed.
Carlos M.: Current flow: validation_failed -> fallback route + automatic re-run. That re-run is separately billed.
Ben T.: Two quick fixes: (A) switch to soft-strip (return primary result with warning) or (B) keep re-run but emit a billing header to mark retry as free. Both need product buy-in.
Alice H.: Product favors clear behavior; customers should see either primary-with-warning or an explicit fallback.
billing-bot: Note from billing: we can honor `X-Validation-Attribution: original` to zero-out retries, but need a documented contract + backfill rules.
Carlos M.: Telemetry gap: there27s no validation.reason metric. Support sees fallback spike and assumes infra problems.
Ben T.: Proposal: add `validation.v1.reject_rate` gauge + dimension `reason=[type_mismatch, missing_field, json_malformed, result_string]`. Also trace tag `validation.repair=auto|soft-strip|manual`.
Alice H.: Sampling: canary=100% raw capture (scrub PII), prod default 0.5% per-reason. Store samples in s3 with hashed user_id.
Carlos M.: Console change: show \"Schema warning\" badge and a one-click link to sampled payloads. Add admin toggle: \"Treat validator failures as warnings\".
Ben T.: Rollout plan: 1) metrics + sampling only, 2) console badge, 3) soft-strip on 1% traffic, 4) if stable -> 10% after 48h, 5) enable billing header after billing sign-off.
deploy-bot: Canary started for validator v1.5 (slice: beta). :rocket:
Alice H.: Alert rule: pause canary if validation.v1.reject_rate > 3% for 15m.
billing-bot: Schedule meeting request: include Billing, Product, Support, Telemetry.
Carlos M.: I27ll open RFC for the billing header `X-Validation-Attribution` and sampling schema.
Ben T.: If we need a short-term mitigation, lower strictness threshold and re-run canary.
Alice H.: Lowering threshold now, will restart canary after patch. Thanks all. :+1:
